author: BDKing
quote:
Gave it 1 just for the graphics, but the storyline isn't impressive. It feels like the same forced feminism. 

Thank God we didn't have mainstream feminism in 2000, or else we would never have gotten legendary games like GTA Vice City or GTA San Andreas. 

Even thinking about a world where San Andreas doesn't exist makes me sad because of some uncreative people obsessed with social justice who love destroying everything movies, games, everything.
